Deadline
Away Day Bonus

In the NPFL, home teams win. Everybody knows it — the pitches, the travel, the nine hours on a bus, the crowd. So backing an away player is the bravest thing you can do in this game, and we pay you for it.
Goal or assist away from home: one extra point. Clean sheet away: two extra. No other fantasy game in the world has this, because no other league needs it.
3 of your players are away on Sunday. Goals away from home pay more.
No other fantasy game has this, because no other league needs it.
The Three — and why it\'s not a secret
Three points to the best player in each match, two to the next, one to the next.

The difference between us and everybody else is that we publish the reason. Every award comes with a line from the match scorer who was at the ground. If you think we got it wrong, you have two hours to flag it with the clip. Points are provisional until Monday, 12:00.
We would rather be corrected in public than pretend a number came from nowhere.
Filed by the scorer at the ground. Every award comes with the reason, and you have two hours after full time to flag it with the clip.
Two per club, not three. The NPFL is more even than England, and we are not letting you stack one squad — which also means you end up caring about at least eight clubs.
The app tells you the cost before you confirm, every single time. Nobody should ever lose four points by accident.
Your changes save on your phone first, then sync. If your data finishes mid-transfer, the move is not lost — it goes through when you reconnect, as long as that happens before Sunday 3pm.
Everything you change saves on this phone first and syncs when you next have data, so a dead connection costs you nothing as long as you reconnect before the deadline.
One thing we will never do

You cannot buy points. Not a chip, not a transfer, not a multiplier, not a boost. Gaffer Pass gets you better information and nicer things to look at. It gets you nothing your rival cannot get for free.
You cannot buy points. Not a chip, not a transfer, not a multiplier.
The day money buys points, the table starts lying.
Gaffer Pass
Better information.\nNot better odds.
Everything in Gaffer Pass is information, convenience or vanity. None of it is points.

Free to enter. Always. Prizes are put up by our sponsor, not by other players — nobody loses money in this game.
Cash prizes are for entrants aged 18 and over. Under 18s who win take airtime, data or a match ticket instead.
Lock in my three
If your player does not play

Your bench comes on automatically, in the order you set it, once every match in the round has finished. Only your reserve keeper can replace your keeper, and a substitution is only made if your XI is still a legal shape afterwards.
A postponed match counts the same as not playing.

Three fixtures were postponed in the first two rounds of this season. Other games leave you with nine men on a weekend you could not have planned for. Here your bench comes on, and your points screen says “Match postponed” rather than leaving you to work it out.
